Fixed. The bug was in `do_write_float` (include/fmt/format.h:2703): for values with a nonzero integer part (the `1234e-2 -> 12.34` path), the reserved size counted grouping separators over the *entire significand* (`significand_size`) instead of just the integer digits (`exp`). Since grouping is only applied to the integer part by `write_significand`, the size was over-counted whenever the fractional digits crossed a group boundary, producing one extra padding space and misaligning all values `>= 0.1` (while `0.295` took the correct zero-integer branch, hence appearing shifted relative to the rest).

The fix passes `count_separators(exp)` (integer digit count), matching the `f.exponent >= 0` branch's logic. Verified with a numpunct-based repro (all fields now width 19) and the full test suite (20/20 ctest suites pass).
